stories.title: Shotton: Chester Road resurfacing begins 24 August with night-time convoy working
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council is due to start four weeks of overnight resurfacing on Chester Road East in Shotton on Monday 24 August, with traffic led through the works in convoy. stories.title: North Wales Police say Dock Road response followed missing person report
stories.summary: North Wales Police have said officers spent Monday night on Dock Road, Connah’s Quay, dealing with a concern for safety incident that followed a missing person report. stories.title: Prestatyn man jailed for four years after faking electric car motorway fault
stories.summary: A Prestatyn man who told police his electric car had malfunctioned and would not stop on the motorway has been jailed for four years and three months. stories.title: Couch to 5k graduates run first club 10k for Deestriders at Southport
stories.summary: Jess Howson and Tracey Hughes, who both finished Deestriders’ Couch to 5k course this year, ran the Southport 10k together in just under 74 minutes.
